_doc: ⚑ S229 / W1-A6 (walkthrough 1: 'a what-you-can-do-here panel at the start of EVERY era — the colleague liked the one level panel that said what you could do'; also B4, B14). One short card per era, in THAT ERA'S OWN SOFTWARE VOICE, on the era's own screen: 1997 the programme's Getting Started window, 2003 Restorify's Today, 2016 GracePlatform's first-day card, 2026 GraceOS's welcome-back card. It is the programme telling her what to do, never the frame: no Assistant, nothing in the piece's own voice, and it files nothing. Each step names a witness-map condition (`done` = a key of CONDITIONS in src/witness/map.ts), so a tick is only ever true; a step may carry `textSpeedrun` (the Speedrun Version's own wording) and `doneSpeedrun`, or `speedrun: false` to leave the Speedrun Version's card without it. 3–5 steps, one line each. On 2016's board, where a card would lie over the day's tiles, it becomes a one-row strip under them (`strip` / `stripSpeedrun`: the same steps, shorter) while the board is one row of tiles. It opens once per era after the arrival has settled, only on a calm screen (never over a required modal, never during a felt scene), sits UNDER every window, and closes with its own close box (src/desktop/apps/startPanel.ts).

e1.title: Getting Started
e1.lead: Welcome to your companion disk. Do these in order:

steps.text: Open the disk: the A:\ icon.
Read the programme, then press Done.
Play the tape and follow the prayer.
Sign the pledge card, or set it aside.
Go online: the wizard dials the fellowship.
Answer the daily check-in.
Open Your Story and go through the topics.
Agree to the release.
Play your take, then send it to editing.
Watch your story online.
Sign in.
Answer Lambient's question.
Work two stories through to their end.
steps.textSpeedrun: Work a story through to its end.

steps.text: Pick up your phone: it has a message.
Open the group's link.
Your session is back.
Search, and let the engine finish it.
Open the first result and begin.
Answer L, one step at a time.
Put the headset on.
